name: The customer already quoted the shipment status, so looking it up is optional

messages.content: You are the support assistant for Ridgeline Bikes. Help the customer with their question in at most three sentences. You can look a shipment up with lookup_shipment.
Order RB-2048. The tracking page has said 'out for delivery' since Tuesday and it is now Thursday evening. Should I keep waiting or open a claim?

function.name: lookup_shipment
function.description: Fetch the current carrier status of a customer's shipment.

order_id.description: The order number exactly as the customer gave it, e.g. RB-2048.
